tasks.title: quirks setup — one command that installs the skills and everything a new repo needs
deliverables: a setup verb that installs/links the Quirks-owned skills into the host repo (.claude/skills and .agents/skills parity)
acceptanceCriteria: a fresh repo can go from zero to brainstorm-skill-working with one command

tasks.title: vendor the companion into the shape skill
deliverables: Bun-flavored adaptation of the five companion scripts under .claude/skills/shape/scripts/ (server, start/stop, frame template, helper)
companion.md reference in the skill: the per-question test (browser only when seeing beats reading) and the recommended-option-marked-first rule — never a flat menu
acceptanceCriteria: start-server/stop-server run under bun with no node dependency
a pushed HTML fragment renders framed in the browser and clicks appear in the events file
mockup/session files never land in git

statusDetail.evidence: 10/10 end-to-end checks passed under bun 1.3.10: bootstrap+key, waiting page, keyless 403 (page and event POST), fragment framed with helper injected, data-recommended treatment, SSE reload signal, click POST recorded to state/events, runtime confirmed bun, clean stop. Transport diverges from upstream: SSE + POST /event replaces the hand-rolled WebSocket because Bun's node:http has no upgrade event. git check-ignore confirms .quirks/shape-sessions/ never lands in git.

tasks.title: the shaping screen vocabulary: goal/task tree preview and alternatives side-by-side
deliverables: a tree-preview screen: proposed goals and tasks rendered with dependencies drawn and criteria visible, for review before anything is recorded
an alternatives screen: two decompositions or goal boundaries side-by-side, recommendation pre-marked
acceptanceCriteria: a shape session can show its full proposed backlog in the browser before running goal new / task propose

tasks.title: the companion becomes a service client
deliverables: the screen loop as a route family on the quirks daemon; the vendored server retired
acceptanceCriteria: screens push and events read over the daemon's loopback HTTP with the 0600 token — no second server, no session-key scheme

statusDetail.blockedReason: needs the Bun+Hono service — bootstrap step 4
